notes.title: Cavember Update 2023
notes.content:
- New Island: Cavera
- New Vehicle - Prime Chariot Futura
- New Game Mode - Drive For Life
- Cavera Art Contest Shop
- Players can bump into each other
- Cars can hit players
- Radio functionality
- CNFT Ads Theme
- Sprinting functionality
- Text Chat bug fix: Words don't break the line mid word anymore
- Voice Chat bug fix: Setting to change own mic volume because some people have louder microphones than others
- Pause Menu has Settings and Shortcuts now
- Optimization
- etc.
